scope: idle single probe after formal load; not a repeat of the 30-minute capacity run
recommendations: Move valid result-cache lookup ahead of full lexical scoring, retaining ACL/version hydration and source-revision checks.
Evaluate a PostgreSQL covering index on chunk_terms(workspace_id,term,chunk_id) INCLUDE(frequency); no index was created.
Consider bounded per-query work_mem using a memory budget; do not globally apply the experimental 64MB to the 2GB PostgreSQL container.
JIT was not used by the captured plans; the jit_off timing difference is not evidence that JIT caused the slowdown.
limitations: Probe stops at stored cache lookup before remaining cached-result validation/context assembly.
EXPLAIN shared-read blocks may be served by OS page cache; they do not prove physical disk IO latency.
A single idle profile cannot assign the full 24652.72ms loaded P95 to one node or predict post-change P95.
